修复这些 SSVEP 方法 fit 接收 NumPy 数组而非 MNE Epochs 的错误。
提升非侵入式 EEG SSVEP BCI 基准评估的可复现性。
bullets_en: MOABB PR #1187 updates the evaluation pipeline to pass Epochs objects to SSVEP_itCCA and SSVEP_eCCA classifiers.
Fixes an error where fit received NumPy arrays instead of MNE Epochs for these SSVEP methods.
Improves benchmark reproducibility for non-invasive EEG SSVEP BCI evaluations.

items.brief_en: MOABB updates SSVEP evaluation pipeline to fix Epochs input for itCCA and eCCA classifiers.
items.raw_excerpt: Pass epochs to SSVEP_itCCA and SSVEP_eCCA in evaluations (#1187) _pipeline_requires_epochs only knew SSVEP_CCA, SSVEP_TRCA and SSVEP_MsetCCA, so an evaluation run with SSVEP_itCCA or SSVEP_eCCA loaded NumPy arrays and the classifier's fit raised "X should be an MNE Epochs object.". Add both classes to the check. Signed-off-by: Bru Co-authored-by: Bru <b.aristimunha@gmail.

items.title_zh: [NeuroTechX/moabb] 修复 compute_pvals_wilcoxon 的单尾 Wilcoxon p 值（#1177）
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] Fix one-tailed Wilcoxon p-values in compute_pvals_wilcoxon (#1177)
bullets_zh: MOABB PR #1177 修正 compute_pvals_wilcoxon 中的单尾 Wilcoxon 符号秩 p 值计算。
旧代码通过减半双侧 p 值并按配对差均值符号选择尾部，可能导致错误。
提升非侵入式 BCI 基准比较的统计报告可靠性。
bullets_en: MOABB PR #1177 corrects one-tailed Wilcoxon signed-rank p-value computation in compute_pvals_wilcoxon.
Previous code halved two-sided p-values and selected the tail from the mean paired difference sign, which could be wrong.
Improves statistical reporting for non-invasive BCI benchmark comparisons.
items.brief: MOABB修复Wilcoxon单尾p值计算，提升BCI基准统计可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB fixes one-tailed Wilcoxon p-values to improve statistical reliability in BCI benchmarks.
items.raw_excerpt: Fix one-tailed Wilcoxon p-values in compute_pvals_wilcoxon (#1177) * Fix one-tailed Wilcoxon p-values in compute_pvals_wilcoxon compute_pvals_wilcoxon derived the one-tailed p-value by halving the two-sided signed-rank p-value and choosing the tail from the sign of the mean paired difference.
